parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this {{object}} instance. This parameter is based on ''ifAdminStatus'' from {{bibref|RFC2863}}.

parameters.name: LastStarted
parameters.description: Date and time, based on {{bibref|RFC3339}}, in UTC that the measurement agent was successfully started.

parameters.name: CapabilityTags
parameters.description: Capabilities of the measurement agent that cannot be expressed elsewhere in the data model.

parameters.name: GroupIdentifier
parameters.description: Identifier of the measurement group of interest to which the measurement agent belongs.

parameters.name: MeasurementPoint
parameters.description: Identifier of the measurement point indicating where the measurement agent is located on a path as defined in [bibref|RFC7398}}.

parameters.name: UseAgentIdentifierInReports
parameters.description: If the value of the {{param|Identifier}} parameter is not {{empty}} and the value of this parameter is {{false}} then the value of the {{param|Identifier}} parameter MUST not be included in measurement reports.

parameters.name: UseGroupIdentifierInReports
parameters.description: If the value of the {{param|GroupIdentifier}} parameter is not {{empty}} and the value of this parameter is {{false}} then the value of the {{param|GroupIdentifier}} parameter MUST not be included in measurement reports.

parameters.name: UseMeasurementPointInReports
parameters.description: If the value of the {{param|MeasurementPoint}} parameter is not {{empty}} and the value of this parameter is {{false}} then the value of the {{param|MeasurementPoint}} parameter MUST not be included in measurement reports.

parameters.name: PublicCredential
parameters.description: {{reference|a {{object|##.Security.Certificate}} object that is used to identify this measurement agent}}

parameters.name: PrivateCredential
parameters.description: {{reference|a {{object|##.Security.Certificate}} object that is used to contain the private keys for this measurement agent}}

parameters.name: EventLog
parameters.description: {{reference|a {{object|##.DeviceInfo.VendorLogFile}} object that is used to record events for this measurement agent}}

object.description: This object represents the measurement agent that performs measurement tasks and reporting functions defined in {{bibref|RFC7594}}.
